title: 52nd Street and Allen's sextet
summary: They played Kelly's Stable, Three Deuces and Onyx Club with a six-piece band including Billy Taylor and Edmond Hall.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Did you work with anyone else between '40 and '45 beside Red?
Where did you travel at the time?
No, we just played here in New York on 52nd Street. We played Kelly's Stable, we played the Three Deuces, and we played the Onyx Club, all on the same street.
We had Billy Taylor on bass.
I don't know about the son. He was a bass player, a good one, Hodgkins. They had Kenny Kersey on piano and Jimmy on drums, Edmund Hall on clarinet.
And that was it, you were ready. And did that band stay together a long time like that or did other people come in and out of the band? Did that band remain the same?
From 1940 to 1945 while you were working -
Something like that. Didn't nobody get fired. I don't remember nobody getting fired.
